items.caption: A closer look at the frame and assembly
On the workbench — a closer look
items.transcript: A handheld camera moves around the stationary YANA quadcopter on a workbench. The clip shows the black and white frame arms, four motors without propellers, exposed central electronics, illuminated indicator lights, an antenna on a mast and a connected battery. The quadcopter remains on the workbench throughout the clip. This is a close-up view of the hardware, not a flight demonstration.
